photos.llama_desc: A woman in a black and white cat-themed onesie is sitting on a bed, holding a phone and smiling at the camera. She is surrounded by a laptop, a phone charger, and a small bag of pink candies. The room is decorated with a white bedspread and a brown and gold striped bed … .
photos.oracle_desc: A smiling woman sits on a white hotel bed wearing a black Christmas onesie covered in Santa Claus face prints. She has an HP laptop open on her lap. A lamp, nightstand, and curtain are visible.

photos.llama_desc:
A young girl in a red sweatshirt... 
She is holding a laptop computer and smiling at the camera. Her long blonde hair is falling across her face. She is sitting on a couch or chair in a living room with a Christmas tree in the background.
photos.oracle_desc: A teen girl with long blonde-reddish hair, wearing a red sweatshirt, holds a closed HP laptop while standing. Christmas string lights are visible behind her.

photos.llama_desc: A table with a white tablecloth and a banner that reads "Weih's Family Reunion" in a gothic font. The banner is placed on a table in front of a window with white curtains, and there are several books and a plate on the table.
photos.oracle_desc: A large white banner reading 'Weihs Family Reunion' draped across a registration table. The banner has two heraldic coat-of-arms shields: left reads 'Labiau', right reads 'Ostpreußen' with an eagle.

photos.llama_desc: A historic building in downtown Indianapolis. The building is a large, white, stone structure with a dome on top. It has many windows and a large, central entrance.
photos.oracle_desc: A neoclassical domed building (Indiana Statehouse) photographed through a car window at an angle. A window frame and diagonal line from the car window are prominent in the foreground.

photos.llama_desc: A Lincoln Memorial in Washington D.C. is reflected in a calm and still body of water. The memorial's white marble and columns are reflected in the water's surface, creating a sense of symmetry and harmony.
photos.oracle_desc: The Lincoln Memorial seen small in the distance across the National Mall Reflecting Pool. Bare winter trees line both sides. Blue sky with clouds. The memorial is far away.

photos.llama_desc:
A man in a white shirt... 
He stands in the shallow water of a lake, looking out at the water. He is wearing a white shirt and dark pants. The lake is calm and clear, with a few rocks and a small boat in the distance.

A man in a red shirt... 
He is sitting at a table with a woman in a blue and white patterned blouse and a young man in a blue and white plaid shirt. They are all smiling and looking at the camera. The man in the red shirt is holding a fork and has a plate of food in front of him.
photos.oracle_desc: Three people sit around a restaurant table with multiple salad bowls. An older man with a bald/thinning head wears an orange-peach shirt; a woman with light hair wears a blue floral blouse; a younger man wears a blue plaid shirt. All smile at camera.

photos.llama_desc: A person on a beach at sunset. The person is standing alone on the beach, looking out at the horizon. The sky is a deep orange and pink, with the sun just below the horizon.

A digital display of a swimming event's results. The screen shows a list of names and times for the girls' 200-meter individual medley event, with the top name and time being "Blake, Chloe" with a time of 2:29.5. The event is listed as "Girls 200 IM" and the location is "SOUTH".
photos.oracle_desc: A blue LED scoreboard: 'Girls 200 IM / SOUTH / EVENT 17 HEAT 10'. Eight swimmers listed with times. Blake Chloe's actual time is 2:15.87. The 2:29.5 shown is the running clock at the top right. Sponsors 'Citizens Energy Group' and 'OneAmerica' at the bottom.

photos.llama_desc: This photo features a young woman in a white graduation gown, cap, and multiple colorful cords around her neck. She is smiling and looking directly at the camera. The woman's long, light-brown hair is falling over her shoulders, and she is wearing a white graduation cap with a tassel.
photos.oracle_desc: A young woman wearing a white graduation cap and gown with multiple colorful honor cords and a large medallion. She has long light-to-medium brown hair.

photos.llama_desc:
A woman in a yellow t-shirt... 
She stands in front of a yellow school bus with a white roof, wearing a yellow t-shirt with a blue logo on it, and a pair of blue shorts. She has her right hand on her hip and her left hand on her hip, with her left foot slightly in front of her right. The bus has a large banner on the side that reads "Congratulations Class of 2020".
photos.oracle_desc: A young woman stands in front of a yellow school bus. Banner reads 'Congratulations Class of 2020'. 'Utica Community Schools' is printed on the bus side.

photos.llama_desc: She is lying on her side, her head and shoulders hidden under a white duvet. Her hair is a mess of brown and red, and her face is partially hidden by the bedding. She is surrounded by a white bed, with a few pillows and a white sheet.
photos.oracle_desc: A person mostly buried under white hotel bedding with only their face and dark hair visible peeking out. They appear to be looking at the camera, not sleeping.

photos.llama_desc: A group of people in front of a castle. They are standing on a paved road, with a large, multi-towered castle in the background. The castle has a central, high, pointed tower and several lower, more rounded towers.

A woman in a graduation cap... 
She is smiling and wearing a white graduation cap. She has long, wavy blonde hair and is wearing a yellow or orange gown. She is standing in front of a white building with a window behind her.

A woman in a white graduation gown... 
She is wearing a white graduation cap and a long, white, buttoned-up gown. She is smiling and holding a diploma.
photos.oracle_desc: A young woman in a white graduation cap and gown with multiple colorful honor cords and a large medallion on her chest. She sits on a metal bench outdoors, smiling. A gazebo-like structure is visible behind.

photos.llama_desc: A woman in a purple and pink scarf... She is standing with her arms around a young girl, both of them smiling at the camera. The woman is wearing a purple and pink scarf around her neck, and the girl is wearing a black and white striped shirt. They are standing in front of a dark background, with no other people or objects in the scene.

A statue of a man on horseback in a park. The statue is on a large stone pedestal, with a smaller statue of a woman at its base. The man is wearing a military uniform and is riding a horse that is also made of bronze.
photos.oracle_desc: A tall granite pedestal with a bronze equestrian statue of a military officer. Additional bronze allegorical figures at the base. Park with bare winter trees and blue sky. Likely the William Tecumseh Sherman Monument in Washington, D.C.

photos.llama_desc:
A group of three children in soccer jerseys... 
They stand with their arms crossed, looking serious, with their eyes fixed on something in the distance. The boy in the red and black striped jersey has his arms crossed, while the girl in the orange jersey has her arms folded, and the girl in the blue jersey has her arms crossed, all of them looking very serious.
A plate of breakfast food on a wooden table. A plate of scrambled eggs, bacon, and a biscuit sits on a wooden table. The eggs are yellow and white, and the bacon is crispy and brown.

A family of six standing together. The woman in the white graduation cap and gown is surrounded by her family, who are all smiling and looking at her with pride. The woman is wearing a white graduation cap and gown, with a gold and blue graduation cord around her neck.
photos.oracle_desc: Six people pose outdoors for a graduation photo. A young woman in the center wears a white graduation cap and gown with a yellow sash. Green trees and wooden fence in background.

photos.llama_desc: A group of women in swim team uniforms standing on a podium. They are all wearing medals around their necks and are standing on a series of numbered steps, with a man in a blue shirt and a woman in a green hat standing at the far end of the podium. The women are standing on a poolside area with a pool in the background.
photos.oracle_desc: Indoor swimming awards ceremony. Swimmers on a multi-position awards podium numbered 1-8. 'FIRE' branded backdrop behind the podium. An official or coach stands to the right.

photos.llama_desc: A young girl in a blue and white holiday sweater... She is standing in front of a brick fireplace, holding a pink plastic egg. She has long blonde hair and is smiling at the camera.
photos.oracle_desc: A teen girl with long brown hair stands in front of a brick fireplace. She wears a navy Nordic/Fair Isle patterned zip-up hoodie with 'LOVE' text. Christmas string lights run along the mantel, below a wall-mounted Samsung TV.

photos.llama_desc:
A dog in a car... 
A brown dog is sitting in the driver's seat of a car, its head and front paws visible through the open window. The dog's fur is matted and its eyes are focused on something outside the car. The car is parked on a grassy street with a few trees and a sidewalk in the background.
photos.oracle_desc: Shot from outside a red car through the closed side window. A large brown dog is inside the car. The car's red exterior and door handle are prominent in the frame.

photos.llama_desc:
A young woman in a gray hoodie... 
She is sitting on a brown couch, holding a small blue gift box in her right hand and a colorful candy box in her left. Her long brown hair is loose and her nails are painted a light blue color.
photos.oracle_desc: A young woman with long brown hair sits on a brown leather couch, wearing a gray 'SOCCER' hoodie. She holds a small teal gift box in one hand and a colorful cosmetics/candy palette in the other.

photos.llama_desc:
A man in a white shirt... 
He is embracing a woman with his right arm around her shoulders. Her left hand is on his right shoulder. They are both smiling.

A family of seven people in a living room. They are standing in front of a Christmas tree, with a table to the right of the photo. The woman in the center is wearing a black and white striped sweater, and the man to her right is wearing a red shirt.
photos.oracle_desc: Seven people pose for a Christmas family photo. Christmas tree in background. Older couple in center. One boy in front wearing a gray suit with green bow tie.

photos.llama_desc: A row of cars in a parking lot. The cars are parked in a row, with their front ends facing the camera, and are reflected in the shiny surface of a nearby lake or waterway. The cars are parked in a parking lot, with a mountainous landscape in the background.
photos.oracle_desc: A single dark-colored car parked close to a steep rocky mountain face covered in green conifer trees. Only one car is visible. Photo is rotated 90 degrees.

photos.llama_desc: A man in a grey shirt... is shaking hands with a man in a red jacket. He is wearing a yellow wristband on his left hand. The man in the red jacket is holding a microphone.
photos.oracle_desc: An outdoor event or ceremony. A man in a white uniform with a fire department patch in the foreground. A 'FIRE' branded backdrop is visible behind the group.

photos.llama_desc: A woman in a black and white cat-themed onesie is lying on a bed, holding a laptop and a bag of snacks. She is smiling and looking directly at the camera. The bed is covered with a white comforter and has a few pillows and a laptop charger on it.
photos.oracle_desc: A woman sits/reclines on a white hotel bed wearing a dark Christmas onesie printed with Santa Claus faces. She holds a snack item and has an HP laptop nearby.

photos.llama_desc: A menu board for Pine State Biscuits, a restaurant in Portland, Oregon, featuring a list of biscuit sandwiches, including "The Reggie", "The Reggie Deluxe", and "The Veggie Reggie". The menu board is white with a black border and a logo for Pine State Biscuits at the top. The menu items are listed in a clear, easy-to-read font, with prices and descriptions of each sandwich.
photos.oracle_desc: A white menu board for Pine State Biscuits. Three items: 'THE REGGIE' ($12), 'REGGIE DELUXE*' ($14), 'THE VEGGIE REGGIE (V)' ($12). Pine State Biscuits oval logo at top.
